answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because dawn only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, plume is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any tide approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
